failure: OpenCV medianBlur rejected a float32 one-row boundary with kernel size 9.

assessment.cause: OpenCV 5.0 medianBlur supports float32 only for smaller kernels; the 9-pixel optimized path requires an 8-bit source.
assessment.prevention: Use a float-safe OpenCV Gaussian filter for the 1-D boundary or pin an explicit lossless fixed-point conversion with range proof. Exercise the exact float smoothing path in the synthetic gate before any real input read.
